name: Soccer player, 6 months post-ACL: 16 weeks with the physio's program
story: 25 y/o, cleared by physio. Tue/Thu/Sat/Sun 60 min. Gym, stationary bike. No running until the physio says so.

routines.name: Physio program A
routines.dsl: Gym: Single-Leg Leg Press 3x10 @ RPE 6 | Eccentric Leg Extension 3x8 @ RPE 6 | Balance Board 3x30s | Superset: Glute Bridge 3x12 + Side Plank 3x30s

routines.name: Physio program B
routines.dsl: Gym: Step-downs 3x10 @ RPE 6 | Hamstring Curl 3x10 @ RPE 6 | Single-Leg Balance 3x30s | Superset: Calf Raises 3x15 + Dead Bug 3x10
